title: Markel (MKL) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Insurance value, recovery risks and Bitcoin upside.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Bitcoin gained 155.55% over the stated two-year interval using next-day close. The path included a 71.87% drawdown, so the small-position qualification matters. Price success does not establish a stable macro hedge.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: next two years
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Bitcoin daily prices
evidence.finding: July 20, 2020 $9161.13 to July 19, 2022 $23410.92: +155.55%. Maximum daily-close peak-to-trough drawdown within that window was 71.87%; UTC pricing, no fees/custody costs.

claims.reason: Protocol supply reductions are verifiable, but the same issuance schedule is public before the event. Demand/network effects are necessary to connect scarcity to price; subsequent appreciation alone does not identify which cause dominated.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Bitcoin halving and difficulty mechanics
evidence.finding: Subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks; 2020 cut 12.5 to 6.25 BTC. Difficulty retargets every 2016 blocks, so miner exit can lower difficulty. Reduced issuance is not a protocol requirement for permanently higher mining cost or market price.

framework_lessons: Separate underwriting, investments and controlled businesses.
assessment: The near-reporting-date Markel portfolio and book-value calls were borne out. Bitcoin also gained over the explicit two-year horizon, with severe drawdown. The PPP maturity language overlooks an already-enacted extension, and claims are again treated too literally as people. The preferred-stock ideas and tactical Tesla trade require holding-period discipline rather than retrospective cherry-picking.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
